scope: Read-only historical NN_Simulator and minimum graphs_cold registry audit.

historical_model.state_convention: Coordinate frames x_t=[x,y]; input is v_t=x_t-x_{t-1}; target is delta_v_t=(x_{t+1}-x_t)-v_t; output is 2D delta velocity.
historical_model.edge_convention: Fixed bond topology; edge_attr=[periodic_dx, periodic_dy, bond_length, bond_stiffness]; geometry is rebuilt after every predicted step.
historical_model.rollout: Autonomous explicit second-order rollout after two ground-truth seed frames.
historical_model.box_deformation: Box carried unchanged; not predicted or prescribed per predicted step; only used for periodic geometry.

prior_metrics.historical_p_ratio_method: Custom inferred box-span ratio from positions, not post-fit R2.

spatial_edges.helper: add_dummy_edges: periodic-image radius max(existing bond length)+0.5; zero-stiffness added edges.
